scientific_integrity.limitations: No claims for other characteristics or quandle orders. Independently verified only selected finite-field cases, with general argument algebraic. Zhang 2026 related work available at abstract level only.
scientific_integrity.previously_known: Sangare and Ta already enumerated 40 nonsimple commutator values for the prime field of five elements.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Explicit cyclic group-algebra logarithm, alternating-minor coefficient map, Pluecker decomposability and field-square discriminant.
scientific_integrity.scope: Five-element dihedral quandle algebra over an arbitrary field of characteristic five; additive commutators, not multiplicative commutators.

title: Quadratic-residue geometry of commutators in the five-element dihedral quandle algebra
